root_cause: The R-C runner restored config MC_RTC_DIV but did not update the inherited M10 setting['div'] used by the second preflight check. PX4 accepted DIV2; the runner compared it with stale DIV1 and reported a false failure.
protocol_deviation: The batch halted only infrastructure/data classes, so it started two additional false-failure attempts and a fourth attempt before manual interruption after the first single-run failure.
disposition: Retain the full stopped batch. Do not count it as R-C admission and do not resume or rerun without a newly frozen budget and explicit user authorization.
